attributes.name: accent color hue
attributes.definition: The hue family of the primary accent color used on the page.

values.definition: Accent is a rust, brick or deep red tone.
Accent is a peach or orange tone.
Accent is a cool hue such as teal, blue or green.
Some other accent or no distinct accent.

attributes.name: neutral palette temperature
attributes.definition: Whether the neutral/background/text colors lean warm or cool.

values.definition: Grey-blue, slate or cool white neutrals.

attributes.name: secondary text color treatment
attributes.definition: How secondary text (subtitles, labels) is colored relative to primary text.

values.definition: Secondary text uses a softened, low-contrast tone.
Secondary text matches primary text color.
Secondary text uses the accent color.

attributes.name: metric value color coding
attributes.definition: Whether data/metric values are colored by status or score level.

attributes.name: metric value size consistency
attributes.definition: Whether metric values are displayed at uniform or varied size.

values.definition: Metric values differ in size for emphasis.

attributes.name: accent color count
attributes.definition: Number of distinct accent hues used.
